assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: an original photographic cutout for a pixel-stretch photo editor UI design study. Create a high-fashion editorial studio photo of a fictional adult woman, upper body to mid-thigh, wearing a rich cobalt blue oversized long-sleeved silk shirt and a vivid red-orange sculptural scarf. Short dark bob, serene face turned slightly left, one arm bent elegantly with hand at waist, three-quarter view. Real skin, fabric grain and believable editorial photography, soft side daylight, refined independent fashion magazine aesthetic. The person is centered and all hair, shoulders, hands and garment edges must fit fully inside the image with a small margin. Square composition. Genuine transparent background, isolated clean cutout, no ground shadow, no surrounding scene. No text, no logo, no watermarks, no pixel-stretch effect: the app will draw the effect later. Not an existing celebrity.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: an original photographic cutout for a photo-art editor design study. A single vivid burnt-orange calla lily with a gently bending tall fresh green stem and one sculptural green leaf, photographed like fine art botanical editorial photography, translucent petal detail, soft natural side light, exquisitely real. Full flower and long stem inside frame with generous margin, elegantly leaning a little to the left. Square composition. Genuine transparent background, isolated clean cutout. No vase, no ground shadow, no background objects, no text, no logo, no watermarks, no abstract effects.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original transparent photograph sample for an offline pixel-stretch art editor. Create a photorealistic cutout of a single vintage 1970s burnt-orange two-door sports coupe, no visible logos, badges or text. Three-quarter side view, nose to the right, full car entirely in frame, beautifully sculpted paint, cream highlights, chrome bumpers, black rubber wheels, dark windows. Low camera height, elegant editorial automotive photography, natural warm daylight. Wide landscape composition with the car occupying 88 percent width and generous clear transparency above and below. Transparent background, clean accurate alpha around the whole vehicle, no ground, no scenery, no typography, no other objects. This is the source photograph only: no pixel stretching or stripes in the generated image.
